mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.type, n.is_top, n.status, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) AS publisher_name, n.publish_time, n.update_time, CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_read FROM notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.publisher_id LEFT JOIN notice_read r ON r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notice_read (notice_id, user_id) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n WHERE n.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_read r WHERE r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, type, is_top, status, publisher_id, publish_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{publisherId}, #{publishTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, is_top = #{isTop}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
